Apple___Apple_scab.description: A fungal disease causing dark, scabby lesions on leaves and fruit.
treatment: Apply fungicide (e.g., captan or myclobutanil) at bud break
Remove and destroy fallen infected leaves

Apple___Black_rot.description: Fungal disease causing leaf spots, fruit rot, and cankers on branches.
treatment: Apply fungicide during the growing season
prevention: Remove mummified fruit from the tree and ground

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.description: Fungal disease requiring both apple and cedar trees to complete its cycle, causing orange spots on leaves.
treatment: Remove nearby cedar/juniper hosts if possible

prevention: Monitor periodically for early signs of pests or disease
Monitor periodically for early signs of pests or disease

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.description: Fungal disease causing white powdery patches on leaves and shoots.
treatment: Apply sulfur or potassium bicarbonate fungicide

prevention: Monitor periodically for early signs of pests or disease

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.description: Fungal disease causing rectangular gray-to-tan lesions on corn leaves.
prevention: Practice crop rotation and residue management

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.description: Fungal disease producing reddish-brown pustules on leaves.
treatment: Apply fungicide if infection is heavy and early
prevention: Avoid overhead irrigation late in the day

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.description: Fungal disease causing long, gray-green, cigar-shaped lesions on leaves.
treatment: Apply fungicide at first sign of disease

Grape___Black_rot.description: Fungal disease causing brown leaf spots and shriveled, mummified fruit.
treatment: Apply fungicide from bud break through veraison

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).description: Fungal trunk disease causing tiger-stripe leaf patterns and berry spotting.
treatment: Prune out and destroy infected wood
No fully effective chemical cure — manage vine stress
prevention: Avoid pruning wounds during wet weather

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.description: Fungal disease causing irregular brown spots on grape leaves.

prevention: Monitor for early signs of fungal issues

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).description: Serious bacterial disease spread by psyllid insects, causing yellow shoots, mottled leaves, and misshapen bitter fruit.
treatment: No cure — remove and destroy infected trees to stop spread
Control Asian citrus psyllid populations with approved insecticides
prevention: Monitor and control psyllid populations regularly

Peach___Bacterial_spot.description: Bacterial disease causing small dark spots on leaves and pitted, cracked lesions on fruit.
treatment: Apply copper-based bactericide before infection sets in

prevention: Monitor periodically for early signs of pests or disease

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.description: Bacterial disease causing small, dark, water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit.
treatment: Remove and destroy infected plant material
prevention: Avoid overhead watering and working with wet plants
Monitor for early signs of pests or disease

Potato___Early_blight.description: Fungal disease causing dark concentric-ring spots on lower leaves.

Potato___Late_blight.description: Aggressive fungal-like disease (Phytophthora) causing rapid leaf and tuber rot.

prevention: Maintain proper watering and soil drainage
Maintain good air circulation between canes
Monitor periodically for early signs of pests or disease
Monitor for pests and disease regularly

Squash___Powdery_mildew.description: Fungal disease causing white powdery spots on leaves and stems, reducing yield.
treatment: Apply sulfur, potassium bicarbonate, or neem oil fungicide

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.description: Fungal disease causing purplish spots that merge into scorched-looking blotches on leaves.

prevention: Monitor periodically for early signs of pests or disease

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.description: Bacterial disease causing small, dark, water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit.

Tomato___Early_blight.description: Fungal disease with dark concentric-ring spots, usually on older leaves first.

Tomato___Late_blight.description: Aggressive disease causing large, water-soaked, rapidly spreading lesions.
treatment: Remove and destroy infected plants promptly

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.description: Fungal disease causing pale spots on upper leaf surfaces with mold underneath.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.description: Fungal disease causing small circular spots with dark borders and gray centers.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.description: Pest damage (not fungal) causing stippled, yellowing leaves and fine webbing.
treatment: Spray plants with water to dislodge mites
prevention: Keep plants well-watered (mites thrive in drought stress)

Tomato___Target_Spot.description: Fungal disease causing concentric ring lesions similar to early blight.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.description: Viral disease spread by whiteflies, causing yellowing, curling, and stunted growth.
treatment: No cure — remove and destroy infected plants
prevention: Use insect netting or reflective mulch to deter whiteflies

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.description: Viral disease causing mottled light/dark green patterns and leaf distortion.
treatment: No cure — remove and destroy infected plants

prevention: Monitor for early signs of pests or disease
